newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close higher as blue chips gain.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close higher as blue chips gain.

text.p: Dhaka share prices moved upwards slightly on Tuesday as the retail investors showed interest in buying blue chips, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index closed 3.56 points or 0.19 percent up at 1,874.53 on turnover of 45.6 million taka. Of 88 traded issues, 39 gained and 47 lost.
Leasing stock IDLC lost 89 taka to 4,012, Bangladesh Tobacco Company gained 13 to 200 and AMCL Pran rose 35 to 805.
